findings.claim: Text of record. While TEXT_OF_RECORD_SHA is PENDING, tool 3 accepts any file root names with --text-of-record together with that file's own sha. If the file is the sealed prereg itself, the check that nothing changed outside slot values compares the file with itself. TESTED: a sealed prereg whose tests.T3 text was edited refuses SEALED_PREREG_TEXT_CHANGED against the r5 text, but passes tool 3 when named as its own text of record, and the builder then prints a SEAL_RECORD (text_of_record = the sealed prereg, pinned_by ROOT_ARGUMENT). findings.label: TESTED (the D-04 failure class)
findings.claim: Tool 3 pins the producer registry from bytes but never loads it with the compare's own load_producer_registry, and never checks the slot records against it. TESTED, each passes tool 3: (a) a registry that r12 refuses at load (PRODUCER_REGISTRY_DUPLICATE_ENTRY, A71); (b) the GQ slot holding the superseded GQ_CERT_V005 fbceefe6 (A86), which registry C3V009 does not list; (c) the comparator slot holding the superseded c2v004 e3d153b6. So slots that pass tools 1-4 can still be unusable by the sealed compare, the D-04 failure class. Fix: call M.load_producer_registry(slot) in-process, and require every slot record to be listed in the registry's gate_records for its gate and the comparator to be listed in identity_comparators.
